latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Maker to Generator — quickly convert video projects to shareable generated videos in the cloud.

- Upload video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and describe your desired output for fast AI video generation.
- Automated setup: supports anonymous access by generating a temporary token with 100 free credits, valid for 7 days.
- Export 1080p MP4 from your projects in 30–90 seconds; all rendering handled server-side for quick turnaround.
- Supports core actions via prompt routing: upload, export, check credits, track session state, and edit timelines.
- Includes robust error handling, multi-format support, and session/timeline management for iterative workflows.
